findings.title: The empty model reply is not rejected
findings.what_happens: The test `test_empty_reply_is_rejected` fails: an error was expected for an empty reply and none was raised.
findings.why_matters: The requirement asks to detect empty replies and report them with their real cause.
findings.hint: What should your code do when the reply comes back empty? If you want, we can look into the cause together.

findings.title: The route calls the model client directly
findings.what_happens: One route case uses the SDK without going through the service.
findings.why_matters: Any change of provider forces changes in the routes layer.
findings.hint: Which part of the logic should live in the service?

findings.title: Variable name is not descriptive
findings.what_happens: The variable is called `x`, and its meaning is only clear after reading the whole block.
findings.why_matters: It doesn't affect how the code works, only how easy it is to read.
findings.hint: What name would describe its content better?

reflection.conclusion: Good work on configuration and security. The main issue is the validation of empty replies.
reflection.question: Which test would fail if someone removed the check for the empty string?
